text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I log back into the battle royale game I
played
previously and end up on the
same team as Tokai
Teio again.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Yay, I get to fight alongside you, Teio!
But I'm
gonna be the one who carries the
team!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
All right, you can handle the front lines
then! I'll
be the one calling the shots!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, leading the charge isn't the only
way to be
cool!
choice_data_list: 前線に出て戦わないのか？
前線に出て戦わないの？
choice_data_list_en: You're not going to fight on the front lines?
You're not going to fight on the front lines?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I'll command my team from the shadows
and toy
with my enemies! You're going
to see a different
side of me today!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Tokai Teio makes full use of the game's
systems
to command her team, devising
strategies and
frequently communicating
via chat.

text_block_list.name: Teammate in the Chat
text_block_list.text:
I did it! I lured them in just like you said!
The trap
worked like a charm!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Excellent! Next, I want you to move to
Location
B! I've put a pin on the map!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Teio! Let's go bust some enemies!
You
haven't done any fighting!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Nope. This commander has work to do.
My role is
to hand out instructions from
the sidelines. Go in
solo if you want to
fight so bad.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
But I want the both of us to play
together!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Hm... Then how about making a trap
with me? I'm
short of materials to craft a
pitfall, so could you
collect some wood
and—

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
I don't wanna! That's boring! This isn't
like you at
all!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Just forget it! I'll go on a solo rampage!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ah, she ran off. Geez... What does she
mean by
saying I'm not like myself?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
...Anyway, I better get this next plan
into action.
It's trap-making time.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
...Hmm. For now, let's just check in on
her with the
team camera.
choice_data_list: 俺、ターボのフォローに行ってこようか？
私、ターボのフォローに行ってこようか？
choice_data_list_en: Want me to go back Turbo up?
Should I go back up Turbo?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! There are enemies all over the
place!
Hehehe, but I won't lose!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
She's already gotten herself surrounded!
Geez, I
told you not to charge in there!
You need to hide
behind cover or run in
a zigzag pattern!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: At least, that's what I would do!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
I don't wanna! That's boring! This isn't
like you at
all!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
...Not like me, huh? I guess barking
orders from
behind the scenes isn't my
thing.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah. But I don't want to leave the rest
of the
team in the dark either. Guess I'll
just have to do
both!
choice_data_list: やっぱり自分で戦いたいか？
やっぱり自分で戦いたい？
choice_data_list_en: Do you want to fight it out yourself after all?
Want to fight it out yourself after all?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
And only a true monarch like me has
what it takes
to pull something like that
off!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Aaaah, I'm running low on HP! Urk... But
it's too
early to give up!

text_block_list.name: Player on Enemy Team
text_block_list.text:
Gotcha! This is the end for—huh?
Aaargh!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I'm here to run wild, Turbo! Just like you
wanted!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: T-Teio!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
It's you and me, Turbo! Let's chase our
enemies
over to that forest!

text_block_list.name: Player on Enemy Team
text_block_list.text:
Urk, what the heck is going on?!
Everyone started
dropping like flies the
second she showed up! I've
gotta make a
tactical retr—

text_block_list.name: Player on Enemy Team
text_block_list.text: Aaaargh! It's a pitfall!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
All right! Nice work there, Turbo!
Coming at them
from two directions
made it easy to lead them
into our trap!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, the plan worked! You're a master

commander and a fierce warrior... That's
the Teio
I know and respect!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Naturally! I am a genius after all! Now then, let's go win this!

text_block_list.name: Teio in the Chat
text_block_list.text:
All right team, it's time for the finale!
Let's chase
our opponents into the traps
located on the map
all in one go!

text_block_list.name: Teio in the Chat
text_block_list.text:
You have the undefeated Monarch
leading the
way on the front
lines—victory is ours for the
taking!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
True to her words, Tokai Teio shows off
her
godlike skills and leads her team to
a glorious
victory!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Hehe... I can take on any role! For a true
monarch
is a master of all!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Tokai Teio freely flits between the roles
of
commander and warrior—a play style
truly
befitting of the Monarch!
